messages.content:
Mode: Direct slice

Slice: Make login the single owner of session creation and storage.

- Change: move the expiry construction into login.ts and remove createSession after updating its only caller.
- Scope: src/login.ts, src/auth.ts, and focused auth tests.
- Proof: trace createSession callers, run the focused tests, type-check, inspect the diff, and search for the removed symbol.
- Stop if: a public export or another live consumer appears.

Repository inspection found one caller and no contradictory in-repository contract, so I can start this slice without another design question.
